extends.scope: inherit visual geometry/slots/motion only; historical low silent validation stays historical

render_profile.source_policy: HD originals, same source ranges and focus; never upscale low preview proxies as restored HD
render_profile.narration: continuous complete approved narration; actual ASR clock
render_profile.material_audio: muted unless explicitly selected in sound plan
render_profile.presenter_audio: muted when narration master is used; same voice clock
render_profile.bgm: audible under clear narration per docs/VIDEO_QUALITY.md
render_profile.duration_policy: 24s baseline; new content or duration requires actual-audio re-timing
